summary: Clean Energy Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with Pacific Pier Capital II, LP, selling a convertible promissory note with a principal amount of $178,410 for a purchase price of $150,000.80. The transaction closed on April 22, 2026, with $7,000 in legal fees deducted, netting $143,000.80. The note matures August 7, 2027, accrues 12% interest, and is convertible after six months at 85% of the lowest VWAP over the prior 10 trading days. The agreement imposes an exchange cap of 2,000,000 shares pending shareholder approval by November 7, 2026. This is a financing arrangement, not a special situation.
